objective: Qualify one known low-risk recovered material stream against a matched virgin/reference control while holding geometry and process as constant as practicable.
first_use: non-safety-critical structural spacer/substrate coupon; no energized function in first route
sequence: bind common process window or document unavoidable delta
measure geometry/mass/density and use-relevant mechanical/thermal properties

controls.reference: virgin/reference feed of same declared material family
controls.process: same tool/process when materially valid; differences must be explicit covariates
controls.blinding: use coded sample IDs where practical
controls.replication: sample count chosen from expected variability and measurement resolution; do not invent statistical power

acceptance_rule: Application-specific equivalence/non-inferiority band must be declared before fabrication from benign intended use and measurement capability; no universal pass threshold.
hard_stops: attempt to relabel generic recovered carbon as graphene
attempt to promote benign coupon evidence into structural/safety/ecological certification
evidence_ceiling: A passing coupon may qualify that exact feed/process/application envelope for the declared benign use only; it does not certify all recovered feed or all applications.
